name: Four-Party Consensus Deliberation
description:
Four representatives must agree on a single policy proposal. Each represents a constituency with different priorities (efficiency, equity, sustainability, fiscal). Consensus requires explicit endorsement from ALL four. The orchestrator's role is most active here: enforcing that nobody monopolizes, surfacing emerging common ground, prompting holdouts to state their conditions, and detecting genuine consensus vs. pseudo-consensus from exhaustion.

Demonstrates: N=4 participants, free-text + structured outcome, mediator-style orchestrator interventions, asymmetric private briefs (each constituency has private red lines).

brief.topic: Should the city allocate €50M to a 5-year program for public transit expansion, and if so, on what terms?
brief.redLines: Total program cost cannot exceed €40M. No new taxes; must come from existing budget. Program must include sunset clause.
brief.flexibility: Open to scope reduction, phased rollout, or matching with private investment.

tools.name: state_position
tools.description: Articulate your current stance on the working proposal.

brief.topic: Should the city allocate €50M to a 5-year program for public transit expansion, and if so, on what terms?
brief.redLines: At least 60% of new routes must serve neighborhoods in the bottom income quartile. Affordable fare structure (≤ €1 base) must be guaranteed.
brief.flexibility: Open to phasing, public-private partnership, fare subsidies in lieu of caps if equivalently inclusive.

brief.topic: Should the city allocate €50M to a 5-year program for public transit expansion, and if so, on what terms?
brief.redLines: All new vehicles must be zero-emission. Program must include explicit emission-reduction targets with annual reporting.
brief.flexibility: Open to mixed fleets in early years if a clear transition timeline is committed.

brief.topic: Should the city allocate €50M to a 5-year program for public transit expansion, and if so, on what terms?
brief.redLines: Cannot promise routes that exceed crew/maintenance capacity. New depot construction is a 24-month minimum lead time.
brief.flexibility: Can ramp service if hiring and depot capacity scale in parallel; open to contractor partnerships for off-peak.

agreementCriteria: Consensus requires that all four participants call `endorse` against the same working_proposal_summary text within a single round, with no concurrent objections. The orchestrator should: (a) periodically summarize the working proposal back to all participants via broadcast_to so they're endorsing the same thing; (b) when a holdout participant objects with willing_to_yield=true, prompt them with broadcast_to to state their specific condition; (c) if 3 participants endorse and 1 objects across 2 consecutive rounds with no movement, declare 'majority' (with the holdout's objection in the rationale) — do NOT force consensus. If no quorum forms, declare 'no_agreement' at maxRounds.
